title: Source generator checkpoint
prompt: Implement `static (int trees, bool symbolResolved) RunGenerator(string userSource)`: build a generator that reads classes marked `[Gen]` (an attribute the generator itself creates via RegisterPostInitializationOutput) and emits a static class `GenCatalog` with one method per marked class: `public static string Name_X() => "X";`. Parse userSource, add the attribute source, run CSharpGeneratorDriver, and return (generated tree count including the init output, whether symbol `GenCatalog` resolves in the output compilation).

tests.name: generation
